explorer.name: the cabin
explorer.title: Airplane interior, in 3D
explorer.blurb: Rebuilt from parts measured off the nine camera angles and their depth buffers: one cabin cross-section swept end to end, and one seat placed 13 times. Cartoon is a low-poly remake under real lights; Photo keeps the original 1995 renders as textures. Actors are 3DMM's own, models, textures and animation untouched.
